title: Black Clover Season 2 Announces October 3 Premiere
content: Black Clover Season 2 anime has officially announced that it will premiere on October 3, 2026. The anime previously revealed the main trailer and theme song by rock band WANIMA, as well as confirmed that Ayataka Tanemura will return to direct the anime’s second season.

title: The Power of Will: Rie Takahashi and Saori Hayami on Rediscovering 'Magic Knight Rayearth'
content: Since its debut in 1993, CLAMP 's Magic Knight Rayearth has remained a beloved classic, remembered for its memorable heroines, imaginative fantasy world, and themes of friendship and willpower.
author: MyAnimeList

title: Katekyo Hitman Reborn! Releases Creditless Third Anime Ending Featuring "Echo again" by SPLAY
content: Katekyo Hitman REBORN! anime has officially released the creditless version of its third ending, featuring the song “Echo again” by SPLAY. The song was used in Episodes 30-38, while the new video was released as part of the series’ 20th anniversary celebration.
author: Anime Corner

title: You Are a Four Leaf Clover Romantic Suspense Manga Gets Anime
content: Manga creator Koushi announced on Tuesday that an anime adaptation of Koushi 's You Are a Four Leaf Clover ( Kimi wa Yotsuba no Clover ) manga has been green-lit. Koushi launched the manga in Akita Shoten 's Weekly Shōnen Champion magazine in July 18, 2024. Akita Shoten published the 10th volume on September 8.
author: ANN

title: 7 Iconic Shonen Jump Manga That Every True Fan Needs to Read
content: For several decades now, shonen series have always been at the center of the spotlight in the anime and manga industry. The demographic continues to dominate the industry even now, which is why most of the popular series released every quarter are Shonen.
